items.title: Switzerland plans deportation of seriously injured Somali citizen
items.description: As we have learnt from two individuals affected, Swiss police authorities use an enormous amount of violence during forced deportations. From the perspective of lawyers and Swiss human rights organisations, the authorities are thereby committing massive violations of Swiss and international law. Furthermore, in at least two cases, they have put the lives of those affected at serious risk. Augenauf shares this assessment and has informed the relevant authorities (including the commander of the Zurich cantonal police and the National Commission for the Prevention of Torture, NKVF). Bot
